scope: Socket-free per-source lease/address lifecycle with ACD readiness and ordered retirement
validated: No address removal before drain acknowledgement
No queued replacement before removal acknowledgement
Stale generation and delayed/replayed grant controls
Neighbor isolation, monotonic-clock and generation exhaustion
limitations: Not wired into mod or live kernel networking
Requires trusted conservative monotonic grant time; v1 DHCP hook alone does not provide it
Renewal and expiration controls are simulated
No live DHCP renewal, target4.4 runtime or actual-CDJ acceptance
